title: Raycast - Your shortcut to everything
summary: A collection of powerful productivity tools all within an extendable launcher.
body_markdown:
## AI Credits and New Pro Plans


This update introduces AI credits and a new Max plan. Raycast AI is moving to usage-based pricing, with monthly credits included in every paid plan. Different models and requests use different amounts of credits, and the new AI Usage view makes it easy to check your balance and see where your credits go.


Pro includes 500 credits a month, and Advanced AI is now called Pro+, with 3,000 credits. Need more room for AI? Max includes 7,500 credits a month for more demanding work. Prices for existing Pro and Advanced AI subscriptions stay the same.


## ✨ New


- **AI:** Added Raycast AI Credits and the new Max plan, with clear monthly allowances for Pro, Pro+, and Max


## 💎 Improvements


- **AI:** Added credit balances, usage details, and relative cost indicators in the model picker
- **AI:** Using your own AI provider API keys now requires a Raycast Pro plan.
- **AI:** Models are now grouped more consistently by provider, including models from Vercel AI Gateway
- **AI:** Improved chat reliability when tools fail and while preparing longer conversations
- **AI** : Apple Health tool now support write access, allowing you to add nutrition info (water, protein, caffeine, etc)
- **Snippets:** Expansions now work after symbols and immediately after another expansion
- **Home:** Tap the selected tab again to quickly scroll back to the top
- **Dictation:** Improved reliability when the active audio device changes


## 🐞 Fixes


- **AI:** Failed attachments now show clear recovery actions and can be removed
- **AI:** Fixed crashes and layout issues affecting source links
- **AI:** Fixed Quick AI model selection not refreshing after changes
- **AI:** Fixed an issue where prompts from desktop automation runs appeared blank on iOS
- **Notes:** Fixed Markdown appearing in titles of notes created by AI
- **Subscriptions:** Fixed the previous account’s plan briefly appearing after signing in with a different account.
